description: Zero-downtime migration, database cloning, and disaster recovery extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.
section_title: Database Migration, Cloning, and Disaster Recovery
section_subtitle: Zero-downtime migration, database cloning, and disaster recovery extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.

capabilities.title: Database Disaster Recovery with Near-Zero Downtime
capabilities.description: Protect Kubernetes databases against data center failures with automated failover and recovery, with near-zero data loss for critical workloads.
benefits: Automatic database failover, or manual if you prefer
Zero data loss with synchronous replication when needed
Planned switchover for maintenance and recovery drills
Automated Database Backup and Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR)

capabilities.title: Live Database Migration with Zero Downtime
capabilities.description: Move to KubeDB from another cloud or on-premises while your applications keep running. Your current database serves traffic until you decide to switch.
benefits: Powered by KubeDB Courier, enabled with one Helm flag
No maintenance window: your users stay online throughout
Continuous sync keeps both sides in step until cutover
Cut over in minutes, with every step versioned and tracked

capabilities.title: Database Cloning and Branching for Dev/Test
capabilities.description: Give developers and test pipelines realistic copies of production databases without putting production at risk. Isolated branches are coming next.
benefits: Built on KubeDB Courier, the engine behind migration
Realistic data for development, testing, and upgrades
Production stays untouched, protected, and fully isolated
Same simple, declarative experience as all of KubeDB
